description: Proposal of Application Notice: construction of data centre building(s), together with associated development, infrastructure and utilities including flexible commercial/industrial buildings, substation, and battery energy storage (BES) and generation (if BES greater than 50MW it will form a separate application to the ECU for Section 36 consent) — Land At Lancaster Avenue, Chapelhall.
decision_notes: PAN 'Comments' decision issued 2026-01-19 (standard PAN acknowledgement enabling a major application after 12 weeks).

description: EIA screening opinion request: proposed data centre development and associated landscaping, access works and other infrastructure. Developer's screening report describes 'a c.100-124MW green data centre providing data management services for public sector, business and industry customers', characterised as Class 6 Storage & Distribution use.
decision_notes: Determined in nine working days. APRS reports the developer's screening report was initially absent from the portal (obtained via a council request taking two weeks) and the screening opinion itself was only published on 2026-07-20; APRS describes the screening report as inadequate, with no layout diagram of the proposed development.

description: Planning-permission-in-principle application for DV4 at Lancaster Avenue, announced as submitted by DataVita on 2 September 2026. The developer says the design was revised after consultation, including a maximum height reduction from 30 m to 26 m.
decision_notes: Developer-announced submission only. No application reference or validation date was present in North Lanarkshire Council's weekly list when checked on 3 September 2026; it is not counted as a live formal application until an official record appears.
